description: Defines minimal public types for Microsoft Teams SDK interactions, including activity and turn context structures.

methods.name: sendActivity
methods.description: Sends a single activity or message within the MS Teams context.

methods.name: sendActivities
methods.description: Sends multiple activities/messages within the MS Teams context.

methods.name: updateActivity
methods.description: Updates an existing activity within the MS Teams context.

methods.name: deleteActivity
methods.description: Deletes an activity within the MS Teams context.
